value.rationale: The exact all-step invariant-error crossover is a motivated, sharp numerical integrator benchmark. It demonstrates that even universally positive, mass-conserving and convergent Strang composition can have worse stationary bias beyond one explicit threshold, despite smaller local truncation error. The precise boundary and general a<b reversal mechanism inform trustworthy long-horizon solver comparison, without requiring a general-network theorem.
